intro.title: What Is an AI Age Filter?

content.title: Age the Whole Portrait
content.text: An AI age filter transforms more than hair color. It can guide age-appropriate changes across the visible face, hair, skin, neck, hands, and clothing while keeping the person and photo composition recognizable.

content.title: Not an age detector or prediction
content.text: The result is a creative image transformation, not an estimate of your real age, a medical assessment, or a prediction of how any person will look in the future.

faq.q: Which life stages can I choose?
faq.a: You can choose Baby Look, Child Look, Young Adult, Middle Age, or Older Adult.

faq.q: Do I need more than one photo?
faq.a: No. The Age Filter is designed for one clear portrait.

faq.q: Can I add a custom instruction?
faq.a: Yes. After choosing a life stage, use the refinement field for a subtle request such as natural gray hair or a gentler age change.

faq.q: Will the result keep my face and background?
faq.a: The prompts ask the model to preserve recognizable facial cues, pose, clothing, lighting, and background, but results can vary with the source photo.

faq.q: Why can two photos produce different results?
faq.a: Lighting, pose, hair coverage, image quality, and how much of the face is visible can all affect the transformation.

faq.q: Does the result show my real future appearance?
faq.a: No. It is a creative visual transformation, not a real-world prediction or age assessment.
